topic: Choosing an installation method (comparison of all methods)
queries: which installation method should I use
what are all the ways I can install KST
compare KST installation options
what installation methods are available
I don't know which method fits my site
list of KST installation guides
which method for my platform
content:
The best installation method depends on your website, ecommerce platform, technical setup and available development resources.

Method | Recommended for | Technical requirements | Installation guide
Google Tag Manager (GTM) | Websites using GTM with Enhanced Ecommerce | Good understanding of Google Tag Manager | GTM Installation Guide
Manual integration | Any website where KST can be integrated directly into the source code | Development skills required | Manual Installation Guide
Magento 1 & 2 | Magento stores | Development skills required | Magento 1 & 2 Installation Guide
PrestaShop 1.6 and earlier | PrestaShop stores running version 1.6 or earlier | Development skills required | PrestaShop 1.6 and Older Installation Guide
PrestaShop 1.7 | PrestaShop stores running version 1.7 | Development skills required | PrestaShop 1.7 Installation Guide
PrestaShop 8 | PrestaShop stores running version 8 | Development skills required | PrestaShop 8 Installation Guide
Shopify / Shopify Plus | Shopify and Shopify Plus stores | Manual integration | Shopify / Shopify Plus Installation Guide
WooCommerce | WooCommerce stores | Plugin – simple installation | WooCommerce Installation Guide
Unas Ecommerce | Unas stores | Plugin – simple installation | Unas Installation Guide
Lightspeed C-Series | Lightspeed C-Series stores | Manual integration | Lightspeed C-Series Installation Guide
Server-to-server | Custom implementations where browser-based tracking is not suitable | Advanced development skills required | Server-to-Server Integration

All installation methods support multi-campaign tracking.

If you are unsure: use the GTM method if your site runs Google Tag Manager with Enhanced Ecommerce. If GTM is unavailable and there is no dedicated integration for your platform, use manual installation.

topic: Advanced setup options available after installation
queries: what advanced configuration is available
what else can I do after installing KST
advanced KST setup options
can I send basket information
can I implement the lead tag myself
what is in the advanced setup section
content:
Once KST is installed, further configuration is available for more advanced implementations:

- **Adding basket information** — share details of the products in each transaction with KST.
- **Reimplementing the Lead Tag logic** — implement the Lead Tag functionality yourself when the standard implementation does not suit your site.
- **Server-to-server integration** — track sales without relying entirely on browser-side tracking.

topic: Performance impact and tag load timings
queries: will KST slow down my website
does the tracking affect page speed
KST performance impact
how big are the tracking scripts
how fast does the lead tag load
will adding this slow my checkout page
file size and load time of the tags
content:
KST is designed for minimal impact on site performance. The scripts and requests run asynchronously so the rest of the page loads independently.

Typical timings published by Kelkoo Group:

- Roughly **100 ms** to download the Lead Tag (**2.9 kB** compressed). Asynchronous — it does not block the page from displaying.
- Roughly **22 ms** to download the Sales Tracking tag (**3.9 kB** compressed).
- Roughly **180 ms** for the request to the Kelkoo Sales Tracking service, performed in the background without blocking the user experience.

Kelkoo Group recommends loading the script with `defer` where applicable, to reduce the impact on page load further.

topic: How to find your merchantId and country code
queries: where is my merchant ID
how do I find my merchant ID
where do I get my country code
what merchant ID do I use
where is the campaign ID shown
I can't remember where my merchant ID is in the dashboard
find merchantId in the extranet
content:
To find your merchantId and its associated country code:

1. Connect to the Kelkoo Group Merchant Extranet.
2. Click the dropdown at the top left.
3. Your Merchant Id and associated country code (shown in brackets) appear there.

The documentation's example shows an account with two campaigns:

merchantId | country
100523248 | fr
100507945 | de

Each campaign has its own merchantId and country code pair, so running campaigns in several countries means several merchantIds.
page_title: How To get your merchantId and associated Country Code

topic: Testing your setup with the Sales Tracking Installer tool
queries: how do I test my KST installation
how can I check the pixel is firing
where is the KST installer tool
how to verify KST is working
test my tracking setup
KST tester wizard
confirm the pixel fires correctly
content:
To test your implementation:

1. Log into your Kelkoo Merchant Center.
2. Select the campaign you want to test in the top-left selector.
3. Click the **Kelkoo Sales Tracking Installer** link in the left menu.

The tool has four parts:

- A **warning banner**, shown on all pages if your KST installation is not working properly.
- A **Tester** section that walks you through installing and testing the setup in 3 steps.
- A **Status** section giving more detail on any errors or warnings.
- A **Last Call Registered** section listing the most recent calls received from your KST pixel, with all information sent.
page_title: Test your Kelkoo Sales Tracking setup

topic: Verifying sales are registered and processed correctly
queries: how do I know if my sales are being recorded
when will my test sale appear
how long until sales show in the dashboard
check statistics after a test purchase
verify order values are correct
my test sale hasn't appeared yet
content:
To confirm sales are being registered, follow the Tester wizard and check the **Status** and **Last Call Registered** sections.

To confirm sales are processed correctly, check the **Statistics** section of your Merchant Center **the day after** your test sale. Your sales should appear there with the correct order value.

Kelkoo Group advises checking regularly that sales are still being registered — especially after you deploy updates or changes to your site.
page_title: Test your Kelkoo Sales Tracking setup
section_heading: Verify that we correctly process sales information

topic: Troubleshooting starting point and how to reach support
queries: KST not working
my tracking is broken where do I start
no conversions showing
sales not tracking
troubleshoot KST
what is the debugging tool
everything is broken nothing is tracking
the pixel never fires and no sales are recorded
how do I contact support about tracking
content:
If you hit a problem, start with the **Kelkoo Sales Tracking Debugging tool**, linked from the troubleshooting page.

If that is not enough, Kelkoo Group publishes troubleshooting guides for the most common installation methods:

- Troubleshooting GTM Integration
- Troubleshooting Prestashop integration
- Troubleshooting Shopify integration

If none of that resolves it, contact the support team via the contact form and set **Subject = "Kelkoo Sales Tracking troubleshooting"**.
